title: Credits Taken Off a Retrofit Project Settlement
content:
# Credits Taken Off a Retrofit Project Settlement

How much of the credit standing on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects comes off the settlement depends on whether the retainage has already gone out.

## Rule

Where credits stand on the project and retainage held on it has been released, the whole of those credits is taken off the settlement: **100 per cent** of them.

Where credits stand on the project and no retainage has been released on it, **50 per cent** of those credits is taken off the settlement and the rest is taken off when the retainage is released.

Where no credit stands on the project, nothing is taken off for credits: **0 per cent**.

## Judgement table

| Credits standing on the project | Retainage released on it | Taken off the settlement |
|---|---|---|
| USD 7000 | yes | USD 7000.00 |
| USD 7000 | none | USD 3500.00 |
| none | yes | nothing |
| none | none | nothing |

Until the retainage goes out, half of the credit is held back with it, so that the credit and the retainage are settled together rather than twice over.

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A project carrying USD 4400 of credits and no retainage release on its record takes USD 2200.00 off the settlement now. Once retainage has been released on that project, a settlement worked out afterwards takes the whole USD 4400.00 off.
